intermediate.name: 3rd passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 3rd passage of the finish line (92.4 km)

story: After the farewell riders were honoured, racing began calmly before attacks intensified on the local circuits. Pello Bilbao tried a solo move, but the decisive break formed with Ramses Debruyne, Tobias Halland Johannessen and Alessandro Romele. Johannessen won the sprint, while Enric Mas secured overall victory.
